displayName: OCI-DB-CASS-001: Cassandra — Unauthorized CQL Command Execution
description:
Detects unauthorized CQL commands including ALTER, DROP, and GRANT operations

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_db_cass_001", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%cassandra%' AND "value" > 0
